page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a short two-column block of verse lines at the foot, partly overlaid by a marginal fragment on the left. Running head at top; page number 218 at top left.

main_text.head: DE S. ANDREA APOSTOLO.
SEQUENTIA.
main_text.l: Jam in ejus afpectu Andrea ftas.
main_text.p: Sancte Andrea Apoftole Dei, deprecor te, ut tuis meritis ab omni phantasia Satanae me eripias, & a futura ira defendas, & virtutem tuam mihi ante tribunal CHRISTI oftendas.
Item: Nos igitur peccatis noftris gravati, te Deus poscimus, ut illius (Andreae) qui tua semper sectatus praecepta, tibi placet, nos intercessione tueaaris in aeternum.
main_text.head: DE S. JACOBO MAJORE.

page.notes: Left-margin verse lines are heavily damaged and partly illegible; the reading of the lower left block is uncertain. The left block's line order was reconstructed from the scan and may be inexact. Signature absent.
